粉发垂如融雪，蓝瞳噙着碎露。

风拂过时，像碰碎一朵水汽凝成的铃兰——
她蜷在光影里，连呼吸都泛着初春的怯意，
仿佛一触即化的月光胎体。

Her pink hair cascaded like melting snow, her blue eyes brimming with dew.
The sheer fabric trembled against her bones, revealing her butterfly-like shoulders.
When the wind blew, it was like shattering a lily of the valley formed from condensed water vapor—
She curled up in the light and shadow, even her breath carrying the timidity of early spring,
like a moonlit embryo that could melt at the slightest touch.
